guide.summary: Public agent app, certified App Store partner (approval path unconfirmed). Where the path is unconfirmed, the agent did not find it in the provider's docs.

composio.note: No Composio-managed Xero app exists, so create a custom auth config with your own Xero client ID and secret, and copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard.

need_own_app.answer: Yes. Composio has no managed Xero app, so you must register your own Xero OAuth app and supply its client ID and secret in a Composio auth config.
reasons: No managed Xero OAuth app exists in Composio
Consent screen shows your brand instead of Composio's
Dedicated quota instead of quota shared across Composio users
Shorter polling intervals than the 15-minute managed minimum

scenarios.label: Public agent app, certified App Store partner
scenarios.when_this_applies: Outside customers connect to your agent through a Xero app that you list and certify as a Xero app partner.

hands_on.basis: Estimate from steps; the assessment takes about 5 working days (c13). Implementation time for Sign Up with Xero is not measured.

waiting.basis: No verified source backs this timeline (the agent's estimate was "5-10 working days for assessment review, plus unknown time for program acceptance and listing review").

scenarios.approval: Apply to the Xero App Partner Program, pass a security assessment reviewed by Xero's security team, and complete certification before you can list.
extras: Security assessment must be repeated annually.

modifiers.note: Security assessment must be repeated annually.

prerequisites.title: Own Xero OAuth app
prerequisites.detail: Composio has no managed Xero app, so you supply your own client ID and secret.

prerequisites.title: Sign Up with Xero implemented
prerequisites.detail: This must be in place before you submit the listing for Xero's review. It also provides the minimum two-step account authentication.

prerequisites.title: Stripe and target regions (only for App Store Subscriptions)
prerequisites.detail: Set up Stripe and your target regions in the Developer Centre before configuring pricing plans. Subscriptions are currently available in Australia, New Zealand and the UK.

steps.title: Create Xero OAuth app and redirect URIs
steps.detail: Register the app in your Xero developer account and note the client ID and secret. Register the Composio redirect URI as an absolute URI with no wildcards.
steps.done_when: You have a client ID, secret and a registered redirect URI.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create the Composio auth config for the xero toolkit through the API, using your own client ID and secret.
steps.done_when: The auth config exists and a test connection completes.

steps.title: Apply to Xero App Partner Program
steps.detail: Submit the company application in the Xero Developer Centre. Acceptance is the first gate before you can qualify to list.

steps.title: Implement Sign Up with Xero
steps.detail: Add Sign Up with Xero to your app before submitting the listing for review.
steps.done_when: Sign Up with Xero works end to end in your app.

steps.title: Draft security assessment answers
steps.detail: Prepare answers against Xero's standard, covering API risk rating, authentication, personnel security, encryption and audit logging. Prepare clear listing text too.
steps.done_when: Draft answers and listing text are ready for your review.

steps.title: Submit assessment and listing
steps.detail: Review the drafts, then submit the annual self-assessment and the listing in the Developer Centre.

steps.title: Wait for Xero security and certification review
steps.detail: Xero typically takes 5-10 working days to assess the answers. Certification and listing review timing is not documented.
steps.done_when: Xero confirms a pass and certification.

traps.title: No listing without passing the assessment
traps.detail: App partners are not certified or listed in the marketplace without passing the security assessments. The assessment is repeated every year.

traps.title: Advanced assessment at 1000 connections
traps.detail: Partners reaching 1000 or more connections need an advanced assessment. It applies from the start to Practice Manager, HQ and Tax API consumers.

traps.title: Consent screen names Composio on managed apps
traps.detail: Composio has no managed Xero app anyway. Generally, managed apps show 'Composio wants to access your account' and share quota.

traps.title: App Store revenue share
traps.detail: Sales to new customers through the Xero App Store carry a 15% referral share plus 2.9% payment and billing fees. Selling through other channels is allowed.

blockers.what_it_means: Xero issues a remediation report listing the work needed.
blockers.what_to_do: Submit a remediation plan within 30 days, then implement the changes within 60 days. Xero then re-reviews.
blockers.agent_can_help: Draft the remediation plan and implement the code or config fixes.
